scoring._eligibility: Applied only to roles whose real JD has been fetched (--briefs). A search card carries no requirements, so these can only ever fire after enrichment.

evidence.name: Jewellery Business Intelligence Platform (13 workflows, live)
evidence.line: Built a 13-workflow BI system for a jewellery retailer — workflows generated from source, version-controlled and covered by a 190+ check suite that live-executes every code node before deploy.

evidence.name: SEO + AEO + GEO Blog Content Agent (10-stage pipeline)
evidence.line: Designed a 10-stage orchestrator chaining specialist sub-workflows with a strict JSON schema at every stage, an 85-point quality gate and a bounded revision loop — plus a hard guard that forbids the model stating any unverified figure as fact.

evidence.name: AI News → LinkedIn Publishing Pipeline (daily, live)
evidence.line: Runs a daily 20-node pipeline: five RSS feeds aggregated, deduped and ranked into Google Sheets, an LLM drafts the post, and it only publishes to LinkedIn on a human approval tap in Telegram.

evidence.name: Job Application & Inbox-to-Client Engines
evidence.line: Built an inbox triage engine that polls Gmail every 15 minutes, classifies each message into lead / recruiter / job alert / spam and auto-replies with a per-sender cooldown.

evidence.name: Six live web products
evidence.line: Ships and operates six live React/Vite products — including a browser-only WebRTC video call with real-time translated subtitles, and an ATS resume builder with no login step.

evidence.name: SEO & AI search visibility across six properties
evidence.line: Manages six properties in Search Console and diagnosed a ranking collapse to its real cause — a frozen sitemap lastmod blocking recrawl for 20 days — rather than the obvious but wrong correlation with recent commits.

evidence.name: Four years managing retail store operations
evidence.line: Ran daily operations for a pharmaceutical retail store for four years — inventory, P&L and reporting to ownership — so translating a business question into an automated report is familiar ground, not a stretch.
